title: OpcuaMappingConfig
description: Configuration schema for the OPC UA adapter mapping. Describes how OPC UA service requests are normalized into BASIS authorization requests.

routes.description: Ordered list of route mappings. Routes are evaluated in order; the first match wins.

OpcuaRouteMapping.description: Maps an OPC UA service and attribute to normalized authorization semantics.

name.description: Optional human-readable route name. Must be unique across all routes in the config if non-empty.

service.description: OPC UA service name to match. Use '*' to match any service.

attribute_id.description: Attribute identifier to match, e.g. 'Value'. Use '*' to match any attribute (including operations with no attribute). Defaults to '*'.

action.description: Normalized action verb. If empty, the default service→action map is used (Read→read, Write→write, Call→execute, Subscribe→subscribe, Browse→browse).

resource_id_template.description: Template for the resource ID. May reference {service}, {node_id}, {attribute_id}, {method_id}, {namespace_index}, {browse_name}, {parent_node_id} using {param} syntax. Call routes must reference {method_id}.
